options.file:
oauth-model-alias:
    qwen:
        - fork: false
          # c1
          #c2
          name: "m2"
          alias: ''
          display-name: ' Display '
        - fork: true
          force-mapping: true
          name: 'm1'
          alias: "a1"
          display-name: "Display"
        - fork: true
          force-mapping: true
          name: m1
          alias: Pro
          display-name: ' Display '
    # c3
    codex:
        - {force-mapping: false, name: ' gemini-2.5-pro ', alias: "sol", display-name: 'Été'}
    vertex: #   c4 with words
        - fork: false
          'force-mapping': &s5 false
          name: 'm1'
          alias: ''
          display-name: " Display "
        - {fork: true, name: gpt-6-sol, alias: Pro, display-name: Display} # c6
        - {fork: false, force-mapping: false, name: "m2", alias: 'sol', display-name: Display}

"client":
    codex:
        optimize-multi-agent-v2: true # c7
    # c8
disable-image-generation: " Passthrough "

usage-statistics-enabled: *s5
remote-management:
    allow-remote: true
    disable-auto-update-panel: true
    secret-key: '$2b$10$zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfe'
    panel-github-repository: ''
    base-url: 'example.com:1234/path?x=1'
redis-usage-queue-retention-seconds: &s9 -1
"codex-api-key": [{api-key: "sk-été", 'prefix': "", disable-cooling: true, request-retry: 0, models: [{name: "İstanbul", alias: sol, 'is-compat': false, thinking: {min: 128, max: 32768, levels: ['über']}}], alpha-search: false, priority: 5}, {api-key: key-3, headers: {x-team: 'Bearer secret', "X-Empty": "a", X-Team: ' padded '}, excluded-models: [" gemini-1.5-* ", "<tag>", 'gpt-5.5-mini'], request-retry: 2, websockets: true}]

openai-compatibility:
    - name: ''
#c10
      base-url: 'https://user:pass@b.example/v1?k=secret'
      api-key-entries:
          - {api-key: "key-b"}
          - api-key: "key-b"
      models:
          - "name": ' gemini-2.5-pro '
            alias: ""
          - {name: gemini-2.5-pro, alias: ''} # c11
      disabled: *s5 # c12
    - name: provider-b
      base-url: ''
      api-key-entries:
          - api-key: ' '
          - {api-key: key-b}
          - 'api-key': ' '
      "headers": #   c13 with words
          x-team: b
oauth-request-scoped-errors:
    'codex':
        - {status: 500, "action": "", match: ['*-preview', "<tag>"]}
        - "status": 429
          action: ""
          match:
              - ''
              - ''

save-cooldown-status: *s5

"max-retry-credentials": 4
logs-max-total-size-mb: 10
pprof: {enable: false}
claude-api-key:
    - {api-key: "key-2", "headers": {' X-Pad ': 'Bearer secret', "Authorization": "b", "X-Empty": b}, excluded-models: ["GPT-5.5-MINI"], rebuild-mid-system-message: true, cloak: {mode: "always", "sensitive-words": ["internal name", 'acme', project-x], cache-user-id: true}}
    - api-key: 'sk-été'
      base-url: 'https://ünicode.example/'
      'headers':
          X-Empty: ""
          " X-Pad ": |-
              b
          Authorization: ' padded '
      "models": # c14
          - {name: "İstanbul", alias: '', force-mapping: true}
          - name: ''
            alias: 'pro' # c15
            display-name: "<Display>"
          #c16
          - {name: 'GPT-6-Sol', "alias": " a1 ", display-name: "<Display>"}
      rebuild-mid-system-message: false
      fingerprint-profile: "claude-code-cli"
    - api-key: >-
          sk-été
      "base-url": "socks5://proxy.example.com:1080/"
      prefix: /team/
      excluded-models:
          - 'claude-2*'
      request-retry: &s17 2
      'models':
          - name: ""
            alias: a1
            'display-name': ' Display '
      fingerprint-profile: claude-code-cli
xai: {inject-x-search: false} # c18
devin:
    "sensitive-words":
        - "project-x"
        - 'internal name'
        - Orion
error-logs-max-files: -2
'plugins':
    enabled: &s19 true
    configs:
        alpha: {"enabled": true}
        # c20

    antigravity:
      antigravity-credits: false
    aistudio:
      ws-auth: true
  request-scoped-errors: {}
  excluded-models:
    antigravity:
      - gpt-5.5-mini
      - claude-2*
    claude:
      - gpt-5.5-mini
      - '*-preview'
api-keys:
  xai:
    - name: xai-1
      proxy-url: mailto:someone@example.com # c93
      prefix: "a/b"
      excluded-models:
# c95
        - "<tag>" # c96
# c97
        - gpt-5.5-mini
#   c98 with words
        - '*-preview'
      disable-cooling: false #c100
      keys:
        - api-key: ' key-1 ' # c92
# c101
          websockets: false
  openai-compatibility:
# c60
# c61
    - name: provider-a
# c62
      base-url: 'https://user:pass@b.example/v1?k=secret' # c63
# c64
      models:
        - name: 'İstanbul'
          alias: a1
# c65
      headers: # c66
# c67
        ' X-Pad ': ' padded ' # c68
        Authorization: b # c69
      keys: []
#c70
    - name: '' # c71
# c72
      base-url: https://a.example/v1
      models: # c73
        - name: "gpt-6-sol"
# c74
          alias: 'a1' # c75
      headers:
        x-team: ""
# c77
      disabled: false # c76
      keys: []
credentials:
  concurrency:
    cpa-heartbeat-timeout: 3s
    cpa-cancel-bound: 5s
    reclaim-grace: 5s
    cleanup-interval: 5s
    release-flush-interval: 250ms
    release-max-backoff: 2s
    busy-retry-min: 250ms
    busy-retry-max: 1s
    max-limit: 1000000
  in-flight:
    snapshot-interval: 2s
    stale-after: 10s
    max-part-bytes: 262144
    max-part-count: 64
    max-revision-bytes: 16777216
    max-aggregate-groups: 100000
    max-details: 10000
    max-string-bytes: 256
    staging-retention: 1m
server:
  discovery:
    service-type: _ai-gateway._tcp
    subtypes:
      - _chat-completions
      - _responses
      - _messages
      - _generate-content
      - _interactions
